name: money-bill-saver
description: Review bills and subscriptions across merchants, surface evidence-backed billing questions, and prepare support drafts.

interface.longDescription: Turn supplied or authorized billing evidence into a private, traceable review of current services, refund questions, and other billing issues. The skill checks invoice arithmetic, marks missing evidence, and prepares local support drafts without claiming that a refund is guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Review the billing files I provide and show current services, refund questions, and other issues with supporting evidence.
Check this invoice and receipt for arithmetic errors, duplicate payment evidence, and a suitable support request.
